paragraphs: From the Monaghan test centre on Plantation Road, pull out and take your 1st right to continue along Plantation Road for about 220 metres
Turn right onto North Road and stay with it as it bears right for around 330 metres
Take the slight left fork to remain on North Road
After roughly 400 metres turn left onto Coolshannagh Road
Take the next left into Riverside, where you will practice a quiet residential section
Follow Riverside as it bends left and then right
You will be asked to pull in and move off again, and to complete a turnabout (U-turn) on Riverside
Come back out to the end of the road and turn left
Right to retrace Riverside back to Coolshannagh Road
Turn right onto Coolshannagh Road right again onto the N54 for a longer stretch of about 1 kilometre
At the roundabout take the slight left exit onto Macartan Road, which becomes Market Road straight ahead
At the next roundabout take the slight left exit onto Clones Road
After about 700 metres you will pull in, then move off again, complete another U-turn, and drive back along Clones Road for around 700 metres
At the roundabout take the slight left exit back onto Market Road
Take the 1st exit left turn right onto Glen Road and continue for about 440 metres
Turn right into Manor Wood for a housing estate section
Practice a pull-in, move-off, and turnabout here, then come back to the end of the road and turn left onto Glen Road
Turn right onto Macartan Road and follow it to the roundabout
At the roundabout take the left exit onto Dublin Road and continue for over 1 kilometre
At the next rotary take the left exit onto the Monaghan Town Bypass and follow it for about 1.1 kilometres
Pull in, move off, and continue around the bypass, taking the left exit at the next rotary, then the left exit at the Coolshannagh Roundabout onto the N54
Follow the N54 back toward the test centre for around 1.3 kilometres
Turn right onto Plantation Road after a short pull-in and move-off
Turn right onto North Road take the slight left onto Rowantree Road, and follow it to the end
Turn left onto High Street, left onto Market Street, and continue straight as it becomes Park Street
At the roundabout take the slight left exit onto Clones Road
Turn right onto Scotstown Road and right again to finish the route close to the Monaghan test centre
